name: ERDASAN
recent: ERDASAN 近期有多项董事及委员会人事变动，包括 MISS LEE LISA 与 MR LING CHI HOONG 的职务调整，以及 DATIN ONG POH LIN ABDULLAH 的董事变动。公司也更改了注册地址，并发布了两项「OTHERS」公告。最新季度业绩（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）已公布。
notable: MISS LEE LISA 卸任审计委员会成员并辞去董事职务。
MR LING CHI HOONG 卸任提名委员会及薪酬委员会成员并辞去董事职务。
DATIN ONG POH LIN ABDULLAH 出现董事变动。
risks: 多名董事及委员会成员在短期内相继变动。

recent_en: ERDASAN has seen several board and committee changes recently, including role adjustments for MISS LEE LISA and MR LING CHI HOONG, and a boardroom change involving DATIN ONG POH LIN ABDULLAH. The company also changed its registered address and issued two 'OTHERS' announcements. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 have been released.
notable_en: MISS LEE LISA ceased as a member of the Audit Committee and resigned as Director.
MR LING CHI HOONG ceased as a member of the Nomination Committee and Remuneration Committee and resigned as Director.
DATIN ONG POH LIN ABDULLAH had a boardroom change.
risks_en: Several directors and committee members changed within a short period.
The company changed its registered address.
